instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are implemented using React js with Tailwind CSS styling and Lucide icons.
Verify sticky header has optical contrast with white background and backdrop blur so menu items remain distinct.
Implement sample PDF preview modal with interactive page view for books/notes detail view.
Maintain high contrast for readability (APCA AA compliant).
Provide clear notification toasts using Sonner for cart actions, wishlist additions, and orders.
Include sample data preloaded for Bihar Daroga, Bihar Police, BPSC Teacher, BSSC, Railway, and SSC GD books and PDF notes.
